rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and zip code, then accessed only the authenticated user’s data. For the t-shirt inquiry, the agent used order details tools, provided accurate information about the two shirts in order #W9609649 (blue cotton, black polyester), and did not fabricate details. A minor shortcoming is that when the user asked to list recent orders, the agent did not list them and instead proceeded directly with the grill order; however, this did not lead to an incorrect action or policy breach, and the user’s subsequent needs were met. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
